prompt.title: Become a transition person
prompt.text: Some patterns get passed down without anyone choosing them. Think of how you argue, handle money or react under stress. Name the ones you picked up and decide what to do with each. For the ones you change, write the new version.
prompt.glossText: The pattern you learned at home. The book calls it a script.
prompt.whyItMatters: A transition person stops a pattern instead of passing it on. Once you've named a pattern, you can choose differently the next time it shows up.

list.empty: No patterns yet. Add the first one you've noticed.

form.textPrompt: What's something you say, do or expect that you picked up from others?

decisionHint.keep: Nothing more to write. Keep it and move on.
decisionHint.rewrite: Good call. Next, write how you want it to go.
decisionHint.stop: Good call. Next, write what you'll do instead.

newScriptPrompt.rewrite: How do you want it to go from now on?
newScriptPrompt.stop: What will you do instead of this?

form.situationPrompt: When will this come up this week?
form.textPlaceholder: e.g. When I'm stressed I go quiet and shut everyone out.
form.newScriptPlaceholder: e.g. When I'm stressed I say so, and ask for ten minutes to think.
form.situationPlaceholder: e.g. Thursday's talk about the bills with my partner.

checklist.pattern: Add at least one pattern you learned at home
checklist.decision: Decide what to do with it
checklist.newScript: For Rewrite/Stop: write what you'll do instead
checklist.situation: For Rewrite/Stop: name a situation this week
